title: Parameter Estimation of the Stochastic Allen--Cahn Equation via variations
summary: This paper addresses statistical inference for stochastic partial differential equations. We study the stochastic Allen-Cahn equation driven by space-time white noise and analyze its mild solution. Our main focus is the asymptotic behavior of the spatial quadratic variation of the solution, for which we establish the exact limiting value. As an application, we develop parameter estimation procedures based on these asymptotic results.
